title: Document public contracts and complete release evidence
description:
Encode the consolidated transaction surface in the canonical public contracts and complete the comprehensive behavioral and structural release evidence on the sole repository-state engine. This is the sole leaf accountable for container criterion REQ-08 and completes Group B for the v1.0 source freeze.

## Background

With the repository-state architecture landed on main, the drift/repair validation and the project invariant land in sibling assurance tasks; this task supplies the public documentation and the release evidence that the v1.0 source freeze consumes. No second implementation may appear during assurance.

## What to build

- Public contract updates: canonical human/JSON/schema/MCP docs encode recoverable multi-target publication, drift diagnosis and repair, managed-region semantics, and absent-root publication. The claim and lease surface is documented unchanged. Contributor docs retain integration-only staging; Git evidence stays orchestration-only with core Git-optional and claims Git-required (`@/charter/D-4`). Existing projection/schema consumers remain covered.
- Comprehensive behavioral evidence: in-process and CLI/MCP/schema tests cover profile/config integration, multi-target rendering, shared-target composition, marker failures, manual derived-state drift, transactional repair, idempotence, concurrent mutation serialization, interruption recovery (external and internal journals), Git-free operation, root-publication races, and stable human and JSON result contracts.
- Structural evidence: guards prove predecessor deletion, no command-local publisher or duplicate renderer, no compatibility seam, and no independently merged staging package.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Human/JSON/schema/MCP docs encode recoverable multi-target publication, drift diagnosis and repair, managed-region semantics, and absent-root publication; the claim and lease surface is documented unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: In-process and CLI/MCP/schema tests cover profile/config integration, multi-target rendering, shared-target composition, marker failures, manual derived-state drift, transactional repair, idempotence, concurrent mutation serialization, interruption recovery, Git-free operation, root-publication races, and stable human and JSON contracts.
- [hard] REQ-03: Structural guards prove predecessor deletion, no command-local publisher or duplicate renderer, no compatibility seam, and no independently merged staging package.

## Constraints

- Sole engine only: add no alternate renderer, serializer, capture path, publisher, or compatibility layer.
- Docs state current behavior only; before/after narration belongs in the CHANGELOG.
- Out of scope (plan D19/D20): lease credential/claim-log/claim-command redesign and worktree/data-root binding redesign — the claim and lease surface is documented unchanged.

Blast radius: canonical docs and public adapters, all cohesive release suites, and source-tree absence checks. See `dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md` §2 (project-local invariant and public fit; complete evidence) and plan decisions D12 and D16.
